internalEvidence: Starting instructions were checked on rendered publisher pages, including relevant mode context. Publisher source context: https://www.daysofwonder.com/game/ticket-to-ride-europe/. Finding: The group chooses its own method for deciding who starts. Continue clockwise from that player. Local source SHA-256: c2e66c703b9d1e2921dfb9e4e26718012fe6eb04a39fff48acc091fc05fb8aff. The current product page links this 7281N source. Cover, starting paragraph and final available page were inspected. A complete HTTP response and parser both yield four pages. The separate eight-page anniversary source was also viewed at pages 1, 4 and 8; the differing instructions are explicitly edition-specific. Editorial review 2026-09-23: Rechecked the cited starting instruction, edition, official alternative and variant context against publisher PDF pages. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22.
uncertainty: The current 7281N publisher download contains four PDF pages, although page 4 references later pages. Its starting-player passage is complete and was inspected, but this is not claimed to be a complete rulebook. The filename date is not treated as a publication date.
No starting tie-break is stated alongside this instruction.
The answer applies to the identified publisher file; other editions may differ.
